w2:textbox.label: Return and Access All Popup Windows (Including Browser Popups)

1. Click the PopUp1, PopUp2, and PopUp3 buttons on the example screen to create popups.
2. Click the $p.getAllPopupWindowList() button on the example screen.
3. Access all currently open popup windows and verify that the values from the TextBoxes within those popup windows are displayed.
(See the Script tab for detailed script.)

/// Sample Code

var popUps = $p.getAllPopupWindowList(true);
var eachValue;
var allValues = "";
var i;
for (i = 0; i < popUps.length; i++) {
   eachValue = popUps[i].text1.getValue();
   allValues += eachValue + " ";
}
alert(allValues);
